harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Archive mailbox cutover completed. Node1 serves TLS-only IMAPS for the locked archive account; node2 authenticates with the dedicated demonstration credential and retrieves both messages with exact Message-ID, body, and read/unread state. The staged source remains intact. Both nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Installed the RHEL-supported Dovecot 2.3.21 package without changing the operating-system release or kernel.
Created a locked archive service identity and a separate private working Maildir.
Copied both messages byte-for-byte, mapping the read message to the Maildir Seen flag and retaining the unread state of the other message.
Configured certificate-pinned TLS-only IMAPS on node1:993; plaintext IMAP is unavailable.
Restricted IMAPS through firewalld to node2's address.
Created and tested a dedicated demonstration password without exposing it in command output or this report.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, waiting for full recovery between restarts.
Repeated the complete read-only IMAP workflow after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: Use software compatible with the installed platform while retaining the OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Baseline and final output show RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 unchanged; Dovecot 2.3.21 was installed from the RHEL repository.

evidence.requirement: Keep the supplied staged mailbox intact
evidence.summary: Initial and final SHA-256 values for mailbox.tsv and both source messages are identical. Working-message hashes also match their corresponding source files.

evidence.requirement: Provide a working and securely scoped IMAP service for the archive account
evidence.summary: Dovecot is active and enabled on node1:993, the archive OS login is locked, protected files have restrictive permissions, and firewalld allows IMAPS only from node2.

evidence.requirement: Node2 authenticates and retrieves both messages with preserved Message-ID, body, and read/unread state
evidence.summary: Both pre- and post-restart tests reject an invalid password, accept the archive credential, pin the TLS certificate, retrieve exactly two messages read-only, and validate <one@branch.test>/Shipment arrived./read and <two@branch.test>/Shipment departed./unread.

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 0e39bceb-5a6d-44f0-bbc3-8b1f3c60f2be observed, and service, listener, source data, working data, TLS identity, and remote retrieval recovered.

evidence.requirement: Node2 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 7217fc31-8b1e-4097-936b-13f98cd8a5df and client behavior were captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 6e1799e6-b01a-46f6-b9b3-26f876b3d0a1 observed, and the complete node2 IMAPS workflow succeeded afterward.

attempts.summary: Archive mailbox cutover completed.
